# Babylon.js

`babylon.js` is adapted from `babylonjs@7.54.3`, distributed under the accompanying license and notice. Its array observers wrap frozen methods and define their own overrides, and its rendering stage uses an actual array with `Array` species; these changes allow it to run after SES lockdown.
